protagonist_goal.text: Work out what coverage the fictional family already has.

prior_balance.text: The family assumed its documents were sufficiently organized.

inciting_event.text: A new purchase discussion reveals that nobody can produce a complete list.

first_attempt.text: They begin by comparing another product.

unexpected_feedback.text: The comparison cannot answer what is missing because existing records are scattered.

hardest_choice.text: Pause the purchase discussion and inventory the records first.

final_result_and_cost.text: The family gains a reviewable list but delays the purchase discussion.

audience_meaning.text: Clarity about the present situation can precede a new decision.
